divergence_from_task_script: The task's P1 script read adj.rows[*].quote, but that field carries the adjudicator's REASON for the verdict, not the stored quotation. The determination's provenance sentence — the one record_determination's verbatim check proved against the cited section — is rows[*].cited_sentences (from relationship_assertions.citations_json). That is the set that is ground truth by construction, so it is the set measured. Receipt re-run after the instrument widened (quote-glyph canonicalization; dash-space folding for PDF line wraps; trailing absorbed punctuation; elision marks splitting a span into parts that must all appear in ONE DOCUMENT) — each change motivated by a measured probe failure class and re-validated here: recall stays 1.0.
note: Ground truth by construction: every stored determination's quote came from the section it cites and the verbatim checker already proved it is there. A resolver that misses these cannot be trusted on an answer.
